name: dev.skywake/skywake
title: Skywake
description: Files with branches and vector, full-text and hybrid search for agents, on your own S3 bucket.

environmentVariables.name: SKYWAKE_URL
environmentVariables.description: The Skywake API, such as http://localhost:8080.

environmentVariables.name: SKYWAKE_NAMESPACE
environmentVariables.description: The namespace to work in. Without it, only the index tools are offered.

environmentVariables.name: SKYWAKE_BRANCH
environmentVariables.description: The branch the file tools use by default. main if unset.

environmentVariables.name: SKYWAKE_FORK_FROM
environmentVariables.description: Fork SKYWAKE_BRANCH from this branch when the server starts.
